Security and Privacy by Design
1. Data Classification and Encryption
- Classifies data based on sensitivity levels
- Implements end-to-end encryption for data in transit and at rest
2. Zero Trust Security Model
- Adopts a ""never trust, always verify"" approach
- Implements micro-segmentation to limit lateral movement in case of a breach
3. Compliance Management:
- Deploy cloud-native compliance tools to ensure adherence to industry-specific regulations ( Using Defender for Cloud)
- Implements automated compliance checks and reporting
4. Continuous Monitoring and Threat Detection:
- Deploy a centralized Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) system
- Deploy AI-driven analytics to identify potential security threats across all cloud platforms (CSPM -155)
5. DevSecOps Practices: (Infra-Security-108)
- Integrates security into the CI/CD pipeline
- Conducts regular security assessments and penetration testing"
